purpose.domain_detail: IBM CICS Web Services XML converter driver; part of the EPS (Enterprise COBOL sample) mortgage/loan calculation application shipped with IBM tooling. Converts between XML (SOAP) and language structures for CICS pipeline processing.
purpose.summary: This is a multi-program source file containing the CICS Web Services converter driver (EPSCSMRD) and its associated exception handler (EPSCSMRF), generated by IBM Rational Developer for z/OS 7.5. The driver receives SOAP request/response containers from the CICS pipeline, calls inbound/outbound XML-to-language-structure converters (EPSCSMRI/EPSCSMRO), and handles LE exceptions via CEEHDLR/CEEHDLU. It is part of the IBM CICS TS sample EPS mortgage application.
